title: The floating tool bar holds only tools, and fills the room it has
goal: User 2026-09-29, screenshot of the bar on a video with a wide window (Select, Blade, Text, Shape, Align, More, Grid, zoom): 'why is the toolbar so narrow? Shouldn't it auto adjust based on the available space.' Since c6b356fa (next-video-tool-bar) a document with time folds the bar to a FIXED set (Select | Blade, Title/Text, Shape | Measure) with every other tool under an always-present More, regardless of width. Photoshop, Final Cut and Keynote show every tool that fits and overflow only what does not.
acceptance: ToolBarFold (PhotonzCore, tests first) folds by AVAILABLE WIDTH: given the bar's room and each slot's width, it keeps slots in priority order (the video tools first on a document with time, then the rest in the bar's normal order), never splits a family, and puts only what does not fit under More

No zoom control of any kind in the tool bar: the slider AND the percentage menu are removed, on pictures and videos (user 2026-09-29: 'we do not need a zoom slider in the toolbar... that's totally shitty ux... zoom isn't a tool'). The tool bar holds tools only. Zoom stays where it already lives: trackpad pinch, Cmd +/-, Cmd 0 (fit), Cmd 1 (100%) and the View menu. Add no replacement zoom widget or readout anywhere without asking the user first
More appears only when something is folded, and lists exactly the folded tools; when everything fits there is no More
It re-folds live as the window or the right panel resizes and as View/Edit changes, animating tools in and out smoothly with no jump of the tools that stay
The bar's maximum width is bounded by the canvas area (with the standard side margins)
Pictures behave the same way (one rule for every document), and the fold keeps the lit tool visible: a tool in hand is never hidden under More if there is room to swap it in
Walk at Next defaults photographs a recording at three window widths (narrow, medium, wide) showing the bar filling the room, and More only when needed

log.note: owns these walks: tool-bar-fills-its-room-walk, video-tool-bar-walk, one-glass-tool-bar-walk, zoom-readout-double-click-walk

Built: ToolBarFold(layout, leading:, room:, metrics:, keeping:) in PhotonzCore/ToolBarLayout.swift folds by measured width (tests: VideoToolBarTests). EditorView measures every slot + the tool row + the whole bar (one preference key so they arrive together) and folds live; Next's one glass bar dropped its zoom section (EditorChromeLayout.toolBarSections). New walk tool-bar-fills-its-room-walk at Next defaults: 1600/750/690 windows, panel hide/show, G swaps Fill in, picture. Walks updated: video-tool-bar, one-glass-tool-bar (zoom:false claims), zoom-readout-double-click (now turns next-one-glass-tool-bar off: the readout only lives on Current's capsules). New toolBar claim 'zoom'. Scripts/test.sh 10572 pass.

Adversarial review: a Final Cut/Photoshop user expects every tool that fits and overflow only for the rest: met. Clumsy bit left: picking a painting tool brings the colour pair, which folds 2-3 more tools on a narrow window at that moment (in the audit's rough; not filed, a consequence of the colour pair living on the bar). Grid chip is a view option still on the bar: folded into the IA task's log. Current capsule bar keeps zoom (Current release unchanged).
